_doc: gen3d model registry. Facts from agent-reports-2026-11-01/gen3d-kit/CATALOG.md + JUDGE.md + runs/*.md (primary sources read 2026-11-01 by the kit runs). commercial_ok: true | false | 'conditional' (needs --allow-conditional and is recorded). research_only models are refused unless --use research. weights_rev null = weights revision NOT pinned (owed, JUDGE.md Owed 4).

ranking._doc: From JUDGE.md 'Ranking per object kind'. First entry whose licence passes the guard wins in auto. kinds: furniture (chairs, hard-surface bodies), thin (tripod, camera on stand), round (reels, discs), default.
